title: fumaria agraria subsp. multiflora
intro: Fumaria agraria subsp. multiflora, commonly known as a member of the Fumaria genus, is a type of flowering plant in the poppy family (Papaveraceae). This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help protect against cell damage and infection. The therapeutic actions of Fumaria agraria subsp. multiflora include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and exhibit expectorant properties, making it useful in treating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
